name: SafeSnap
author: PluginJoy

sections.description:
SafeSnap is the ultimate free WordPress backup plugin for automatic daily backups, ensuring robust site security in 2025. Protect your database and files with seamless local storage in /wp-content/uploads/safesnap/backups/. Ideal for bloggers, e-commerce sites, and agencies, this lightweight tool offers disaster recovery without complexity—making it the top choice for WordPress backup solutions.

Watch our quick admin demo:

Why Choose SafeSnap: Best WordPress Backup Plugin for Security

In a world of rising cyber threats and data risks, SafeSnap delivers automatic WordPress backups to safeguard your site. With daily full backups (database + files), 7-day retention, and real-time file monitoring, it prevents loss from hacks, errors, or crashes. As a leading database backup plugin, SafeSnap combines ease with power for secure WordPress sites.

Free Version: Core WordPress Backup & Security Features

  • Daily Full Backups: Auto-saves database + zipped files every 24 hours to local storage—protect posts, themes, plugins, and more.
  • 7-Day Retention: Keeps the last 7 backups, auto-deleting older ones to save server space.
  • One-Click Manual Backup: Trigger instant DB + files backups from the admin menu.
  • Real-Time Monitoring: Scans core files every 5 minutes for changes; logs suspicious activity.
  • Easy One-Click Restore: Restore latest backup or select specific DB/files with a single click—no phpMyAdmin needed.

These essentials make SafeSnap a must-have free WordPress security plugin for hassle-free protection.

Upgrade to SafeSnap Pro: Advanced Cloud Backup Solutions

Elevate with Pro features for ultimate WordPress site security:
– Cloud Storage: Auto-upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, AWS for off-site backups.
– SMS Alerts: Instant Twilio notifications for backups, threats, or changes.
– Unlimited Retention & Priority Support: No limits, plus expert help.

Built by PluginJoy, get SafeSnap Pro for $39 lifetime. Documentation & Upgrade.

How SafeSnap Works: Simple Setup for Automatic Backups

  1. Install: Upload safesnap to /wp-content/plugins/ or search in WordPress Plugins.
  2. Activate: Enable via Plugins menu—backups start instantly.
  3. Admin Menu: Go to SafeSnap dashboard for manual backups, restores, monitoring status.
  4. Storage & Restore: Files in /wp-content/uploads/safesnap/backups/; one-click recovery built-in.

No config needed—SafeSnap secures your WordPress backup routine from day one.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where are backups stored?

In /wp-content/uploads/safesnap/backups/ for easy FTP access.

How do I restore?

Use one-click buttons in the admin for latest/specific backups (free). Pro adds full automation.

Backup size limits?

Free handles full DB + files; Pro optimizes for large sites with cloud.

Upgrade to Pro?

Get Pro now for $39 lifetime—includes docs & support.

Feedback?

Rate us or contact PluginJoy.

Screenshots

  1. Admin Menu Demo: Tabs for backups, monitoring, restore—watch video tour at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tr7eTd5LErs.
  2. Backup Files: View .sql + .zip in /wp-content/uploads/safesnap/backups/.
  3. One-Click Restore: Select and restore DB/files instantly.

Changelog

1.0.3

  • Added files backups to daily routine.
  • Introduced one-click manual backup & restore.
  • Enabled real-time monitoring (5-min intervals).
  • Updated Pro upsell for cloud/SMS.

1.0.2

  • Minor readme updates.

1.0.1

  • Initial release with daily DB backups & 7-day retention.

Upgrade Notice

1.0.3

  • Enhanced with files support & monitoring—update for full protection.

Additional Information
